title: A Parametrization of Solutions to the Yamabe Equation with Isolated Singularity
summary: Inspired by a pioneering work by Caffarelli, Gidas, and Spruck, we study positive solutions to the Yamabe equation with nonremovable isolated singularities. It is known that there is a formal one-to-one correspondence between the collection of the solutions to the Yamabe equation with nonremovable isolated singularities and the collection of harmonic functions through formal infinite series determined by the harmonic functions.
